case_name: Food Corporation of India, Kakinada, Represented v Yarlagadda Narayana Apparao and Others
petitioner: Food Corporation of India, Kakinada, Represented
facts: Challenge in these appeals is to the judgment of the learned Single Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court allowing the Civil Revision Petition Nos.5048 and 5088 of 2001, filed by the present respondent no.1 in each case.
The basic dispute relates to liability to interest on the amount envisaged under Section 23(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (in short the 'Act') conveniently called 'solatium'.
Mr. Amrendra Sharan, Additional Solicitor General, submitted that both Prem Nath's case and Sunder's case were considered by a Constitution Bench of this Court in Gurpreet Singh v. Union of India.
In response, learned counsel for the respondent submitted that the High Court's judgment does not suffer from any infirmity to warrant interference.
issues: Whether the view of the High Court is correct or not
Whether the decision in Prem Nath Kapur and Sunder v. Union of India applies
petitioner_arguments: The view in Prem Nath's case was stated to be correct one in Gurpreet Singh v. Union of India
The High Court's judgment does not suffer from any infirmity to warrant interference
respondent_arguments: The High Court's judgment does not suffer from any infirmity to warrant interference
court_reasoning: We are satisfied that the essential ratio in Prem Nath Kapur on appropriation being at different stages is justified
An execution court cannot go behind the decree

If the award of the Reference Court or that of the appellate court does not specifically refer to the question of interest on solatium, then it would be open to the execution court to apply the ratio of Sunder
holding: The appeals are disposed of without any order as to costs
The matter is remitted to the High Court for fresh consideration
cases_cited: Food Corporation of India, Kakinada, Represented v Yarlagadda Narayana Apparao
that the decision of this Court in Prem Nath Kapur and Anr. v. National Fertilizer Corpn
